says: Final pass on this scene. I sharpen twice now: once before the distant work and again right before the rider and strider, and their contours are gone over three times with the fine point so they stay dark without going thick. On the wall about half the facets are left pure white, hatching stays on the undersides and faces turned away, and four wedge-shaped cracks are filled solid black. The rider gets goggles with white glints, a breathing mask and a goggle strap, plus folds where the cloak bends over the shoulder; the strider gets a ringed eye, a mouth line and a nostril. The far canyon wall gets fine broken horizontal strata.
